extracted.stage: Divorce financial proceedings, next hearing listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Tan & Sallow & Co enquires about a £19,000 litigation loan for her client, the wife in divorce proceedings with roughly £264,500 of assets in dispute and a hearing at the Family Court at Birmingham on 12 November 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have logged for review. To take it further we would need the client's full details, confirmation of her identity, a breakdown of the £19,000 sought and anticipated costs to conclusion, and supporting evidence of the assets in dispute including the property and pension values. It would also help to have confirmation of the stage of proceedings, the hearing listing, and details of any existing charges over the assets. We will send our criteria and application form separately. Nothing in this email should be taken as any indication of whether funding will be offered or on what terms.
